subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 for this issue, or close it and land a narrow replacement fix on current main?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and paired with an open fix candidate, but that PR is conflicting and still lacks real behavior proof, so cleanup automation should not open a duplicate or close the issue first.

options.title: Refresh linked PR
options.body: Update https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 onto current main, keep the hook accountId fix, and require real multi-account delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Open replacement fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale/conflicting branch and land a narrow maintainer-owned replacement that preserves the source PR credit.

options.title: Defer with issue open
options.body: Leave this issue open without a fix path until a maintainer chooses ownership for hook multi-account delivery.

recommendation.title: Refresh linked PR
recommendation.body: Update https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 onto current main, keep the hook accountId fix, and require real multi-account delivery proof before merge.
